verdict.rationale: Calendly's pricing page confirms native integrations that 'join Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams' alongside recordings/transcripts, supporting automatic video-conference attachment to bookings, but there is no first-party doc detailing the automatic-link-generation workflow per event type, no mention of a 'native video' option, and no independent/hands-on corroboration in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation on automatic conferencing-link insertion per booking, confirmation of a native (non-third-party) video option, and independent user corroboration of reliability.
